profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Data Recognition Corporation
profile.summary:
Senior Software Developer, former IBM Champion


Recruiters: if you think I might be interested in contract or hourly work, you're mistaken.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Serverless application and services developer building and enhancing computer based testing solutions, using AWS stack with typescript, node, serverless framework, lambda, CloudFormation, CloudWatch, and DynamoDB. UI work in Angular 10 with Material design and jenkins pipeline deployments.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description: Full-stack JavaScript developer, providing new feature development, issue remediation, and support for a high availability application. Front ends work consists of applications built on Angular with micro services driving the back-ends, with deployments on AWS lambda, with the serverless framework, MS SQL db, and Athena data. AWS console, step functions, athena reporting, and logging, in addition to Docker built images for deployments, built on Jenkins. TypeScript with both back-end and front-ends, amongst other tooling.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Full stack Java and JavaScript developer with a deep understanding of RDBMS and SQL, MariaDB/MySQL and MSSQL, Java 8 and Spring, and front-end frameworks, such as Angular. Also build a front-end build pipeline and provided support for Docker images, Jenkins builds, AWS console, and deployments.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
Full-stack web app and systems integration developer. Working with IBM XPages (XSP + JSF) and Node on the back-end of the stack, along with Dojo, jQuery, and Angular, vue.js and other various front-end frameworks.

Implemented custom build and continuous deployment process. Custom productivity, progress tracking, and forecasting applications for use with company-wide initiative for a highly distributed company.

Named an IBM Champion for three years running in recognition of conference speaking, blogging, and other community efforts.

positions.title: Battalion Maintenance Officer
positions.description: Responsible for overseeing the support, maintenance, man hour logging, repair processing, parts ordering and distribution for all mission critical equipment in the Battalion. The operational readiness of the Battalion is calculated from equipment and personnel functionality, we make them happen. Constant review and reporting of equipment status to provide the best support possible to the Battalion Commander, subordinate commanders, and fellow staff sections.

positions.title: Battalion S4: Supply and Logistics Officer
positions.description: Battalion Staff officer in the role of Supply and Logistics for the 457th Transportation Battalion. Managing of all Battalion owned material, oversight of supply management, and support planning for all organizational operations. Provide support and guidance to Battalion Commander, subordinate commanders, and all staff.

positions.title: CPR and First Aid Instructor
positions.description: American Heart Association BLS instructor. Provide CPR, First Aid, and AED instruction and testing for the city as a certified AHA BLS instructor. Provide instructional services for new and returning students including skills testing and grading written examinations. Instruction given to both novice (Heartsaver) and Health Care Professional students. Incorporate additional information from cyclical information pushes from the AHA.

positions.title: EMT
positions.description: Provide emergency care and transport for the community's sick and injured, maintain national and state certifications through continuing education.

positions.title: Platoon Leader
positions.description: Charged with the mission for and care of a 40 man Platoon, equipment operational readiness, and training. Recently returned from a tour in OIF in a line haul Transportation Company, conducting numerous combat support missions, delivering all classes of supply over the country of Iraq.

positions.title: Senior Systems Technician
positions.description:
Computer systems repair and maintenance, database and networking setup and repair. Specializing in:

-On-Site Service Calls with personal and corporate customers
-System Restoration
-Virus and Malware removal
-Component Upgrades
-Home and Office Networking
-Purchasing advisor to the owner

volunteerExperiences.description: As an Eagle Scout who turned 18 and wanted to continue providing mentoring to our younger members, I was able to do so with my Troop, which took me on as an Assistant Scoutmaster.

projects.title: XPages (Compatible) Yeoman Generator
projects.description: A Yeoman Generator for scaffolding an XPages compliant On Disk Project either in whole or in part, for creating from scratch an application or adding functionality to existing applications.

projects.title: Markdown Notepad Bookmarklet
projects.description: A quick web notepad, works offline, saved as a bookmarklet. Written in vue.js, can save to a file.

publications.title: An Introduction to SonarQube and Docker
